snippet.title: The Futur
snippet.description:
The Futur is the global training platform for creative entrepreneurs who want to learn business strategy, personal branding, and how to scale their creative services.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN:
- Business strategy for designers and creatives
- How to price, sell, and scale your creative services
- Personal branding and offer creation
- The psychology of branding, design, and storytelling
- Mindset, productivity, and wealth-building for entrepreneurs

Whether you're a graphic designer, brand strategist, freelancer, or creative business owner, our videos will teach you how to move from being a "starving artist" to a successful business owner.

NEW VIDEOS RELEASED WEEKLY

Subscribe now to master the business of creativity and the future of work.
